title: Register and log in
acceptance: Valid credentials log in; invalid credentials rejected; password never echoed

title: Create group; join by code or link
acceptance: Unique 6-char code and link generated; invalid code rejected

title: Unique display names per group
acceptance: Duplicate display name in same group rejected

title: Genre-diverse 10-movie selection
acceptance: Each member gets 10 distinct movies spanning multiple genres

title: Interested / Not Interested votes
acceptance: Every presented movie must be marked exactly once

title: Store votes with user group movie session ids
acceptance: Each vote row carries all four identifiers

title: Lock submissions; wait for all members
acceptance: Resubmission rejected; results blocked until all submit

title: Equal-weight group aggregation
acceptance: Member order irrelevant; each member counted once

title: Content scorer over whole catalogue incl. dataset prep
acceptance: Unseen catalogue movies scored from metadata

title: Ranked results: title description rating
acceptance: Top 10 shown in rank order with title description and rating or 'unavailable'

title: Group picks watched movie; members rate 1-5
acceptance: 1 and 5 accepted; 0 and 6 rejected

title: Store ratings and compute group mean
acceptance: Mean of 4 and 2 is 3.0; mean of 3 4 5 is 4.0

title: Input validation and error messages
acceptance: Bad input rejected with readable message; failed save never reported as success

title: Hybrid ranking with per-group Thompson sampling bandit and cold start
acceptance: Configurable weights; new group ranks on current votes + ratings only

title: Store watched movie group rating as that group's bandit reward
acceptance: Next session's ranking reflects feedback; completed session unchanged

title: Ranked list in under 3 s for 95% of requests
acceptance: >=95/100 runs under 3 s with 10000 movies and 10 members

title: Security and privacy (SR-01 to SR-06)
acceptance: Auth required; cross-group access denied; salted hashes; no secrets in errors

title: Data persists across restarts
acceptance: All records survive restart; no orphaned foreign keys

title: Independently testable modules
acceptance: Recommender unit-tested without UI or DB

title: Missing ratings or descriptions handled
acceptance: Missing values shown as unavailable; ranking does not crash

title: Evaluation against baselines (NDCG@10)
acceptance: Hybrid NDCG@10 reported against rating-only and preference-only

title: Usability test with 5 first-time users
acceptance: At least 4 of 5 complete core flow unaided
